privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Transparent and detailed information regarding data handling, local storage, and Google Drive integration in MotorLog.
privacy.pillar_local_desc: Your data resides solely in your browser. No remote databases and no unsolicited storage.
privacy.pillar_noservers_desc: We do not sell, rent, or share Google user data with third parties, nor do we use it for advertising or AI models.
privacy.pillar_gdrive_desc: Cloud backup is optional and only stores an application file in your private app folder (appDataFolder).
privacy.section1_p1: MotorLog is a vehicle maintenance and logging application designed under a Local-First architecture. User privacy is our core principle: the application operates entirely on your device using local storage (IndexedDB powered by RxDB).
privacy.section1_p2: We do not maintain any central data collection servers, we do not require registering an external account to use the app, and we never commercialize or sell any user information.
privacy.section2_intro: All information entered into MotorLog belongs exclusively to the user and stays on their device:
privacy.section2_item1: Vehicle Data: Name, make, model, year, displacement, power, color, and associated notes.
privacy.section2_item2: Maintenance Records: Dates, mileage, costs, performed services, service locations, and reference images.
privacy.section2_item3: Local User Profile: Session username and custom selected avatar.
privacy.section2_storage_note: This information is processed and stored locally in your browser's IndexedDB database and is never transmitted to any MotorLog servers.
privacy.section3_title: Google Drive API Integration & Google API User Data Policy
privacy.section3_intro: MotorLog offers an optional cloud backup feature by connecting your personal Google Drive account. Access to Google services strictly adheres to the following principles:
privacy.section3_scope_drive: MotorLog accesses the user's Google Drive account solely to read and write database and logging files of the application itself (motorLog_backup.json within the hidden private appDataFolder space). MotorLog cannot access, read, modify, or delete any other files, documents, photos, or folders in your Google Drive.
privacy.section3_scope_email: Allows retrieving and displaying your email address on the settings screen solely to visually confirm which Google account is linked.
privacy.section3_purpose_desc: Application data is processed solely on the user's local device and is only synchronized to the user's private Google Drive when they voluntarily choose to back up or restore their personal data.
privacy.section3_no_sharing_desc: We do not sell, rent, or share Google user data with third parties, nor do we use it for advertising or artificial intelligence models.
privacy.section3_limited_use_desc: MotorLog's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacy.section4_p1: Without central servers, your data is not exposed to remote database breaches. The security of your local data relies on your device and browser security. Google Drive backups are protected under Google's security, privacy, and encryption standards.
privacy.section5_p1: You have complete control over your data and can manage or delete it at any time:
privacy.section5_item1: Local Data Deletion: You can clear all data stored in the browser from Settings > Clear data.
privacy.section5_item2: Google Drive Deletion: You can delete your backup file (motorLog_backup.json) at any time from the app or by managing connected apps in your Google Drive.
privacy.section5_item3: Revoking Google Access: You can revoke MotorLog's access at any time through your Google account security settings by visiting: https://myaccount.google.com/permissions.
privacy.section5_item4: Export and Portability: You can download a full backup copy of all your data in standard JSON format whenever you wish from Settings.
privacy.section6_p1: MotorLog is a transparent, open-source project. For any questions, requests, or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or your data, you can reach out directly:

terms.subtitle: Terms of use, scope, and responsibilities for users of the MotorLog application.
terms.pillar_free_desc: Free tool for personal use, with no subscriptions, hidden fees, or advertisements.
terms.pillar_control_desc: You retain full control over entered data and the custody of your backups.
terms.pillar_opensource_desc: Community project published for educational and public utility purposes.
terms.section1_p1: By accessing, browsing, or using the MotorLog application, you voluntarily and fully accept these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any of the terms outlined, you must refrain from using the application.
terms.section2_title: Description and Use of the Application
terms.section2_p1: MotorLog is a web tool designed under a local-first model to help users track, organize, and monitor vehicle maintenance. The use of the application is subject to the following guidelines:
terms.section2_item1: Personal Use: The application is designed for individual and personal vehicle and maintenance management.
terms.section2_item2: Local Processing: All records are processed and stored directly on the user's device.
terms.section3_p1: MotorLog offers an optional feature to connect a personal Google Drive account to upload and restore backups. By using this feature, you acknowledge and agree that storage and infrastructure services are provided by Google LLC subject to their own terms and policies.
terms.section3_p2: MotorLog is not liable for network outages, Google service interruptions, changes in storage quotas, or third-party API policy changes.
terms.section4_title: Disclaimer of Warranties and Limitation of Liability
terms.section4_p1: MotorLog is provided 'AS IS' and 'AS AVAILABLE', without warranties of any kind, either express or implied. MotorLog is solely an informational and organizational assistance tool.
terms.section4_p2: The user is solely responsible for actual vehicle mechanical maintenance, periodic inspections, regulatory compliance, and safety. MotorLog and its developers assume no liability for data loss due to browser cache clearance, device failures, or mechanical decisions made based on recorded logs.
terms.section5_p1: MotorLog's source code is open source. Users are free to inspect, audit, and contribute to the project respecting the open source repository license.
terms.section6_p1: We reserve the right to modify or update these Terms of Service at any time. The last updated date at the top indicates the current effective version.
